author: reek
body: `IrNegate` carried no type field, so a backend that needed to know whether a negation was floating-point had to ask the OPERAND. The compiler's `ir-expr-type` answered a negation by recursing into its operand; the plug's copy answered `int-ty-default`. The two disagreed exactly when the operand of a negation was itself a negation, and then the plug integer negated an IEEE double's bit pattern.

author: reek
body: The node carries a `CodexType` now, lowering fills it, and the text wire sends it, so no backend re-derives it and there is no second answer to disagree with. This test is the repro that found the divergence and it stays: it is what would see the field stop being filled.
